arguments.name: categoryCode
arguments.description: The unique code identifier category code to search (partial supported, but usually exact code works best). Example: "000001"

raw.name: categoryCode
raw.description: The unique code identifier category code to search (partial supported, but usually exact code works best). Example: "000001"

arguments.name: categoryName
arguments.description: Category name / partial name to search (partial match). Example: "academic"

raw.name: categoryName
raw.description: Category name / partial name to search (partial match). Example: "academic"

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description:
Set to "show all" / "all" / "yes" (or any phrase like "get all", "list", "existing", "available") to return all categories across all pages.
(Also triggers automatically if the user types those keywords inside categoryCode or categoryName.)

raw.name: returnAll
raw.description:
Set to "show all" / "all" / "yes" (or any phrase like "get all", "list", "existing", "available") to return all categories across all pages.
(Also triggers automatically if the user types those keywords inside categoryCode or categoryName.)

arguments.name: pageSize
arguments.description: Initial page size to request on the first grid load (default "10"). After the first response, the transformer adopts the UI page size automatically.

raw.name: pageSize
raw.description: Initial page size to request on the first grid load (default "10"). After the first response, the transformer adopts the UI page size automatically.

arguments.name: maxPages
arguments.description: Safety limit for how many pages the transformer will scan when collecting records (default is high). Useful to prevent very large pulls.

raw.name: maxPages
raw.description: Safety limit for how many pages the transformer will scan when collecting records (default is high). Useful to prevent very large pulls.
